text:
When `provider: auto` is configured and remote API keys are detected in your environment, Hermes resolves routing to remote providers and fallback chains.

To force Hermes to use only your local endpoint and prevent it from routing or falling back to remote providers (like OpenRouter), explicitly configure your model and disable fallback providers in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:

```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/your-model  # Replace with your local model
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434  # Replace with your local inference endpoint
fallback_providers: []
```

Setting `fallback_providers: []` ensures that Hermes does not fall back to remote services when an API key is present in your environment.
